settings.controls: Comment edit window (seconds). 0 disables editing. Registered via register_undocumented_settings (no UI; documented in qa/WHAT-TO-CHECK.md).
Active storage driver (local/S3/BunnyCDN — Pro-extensible via mvs_storage_driver filter)
Serve public media direct from CDN. When on AND active driver is s3/bunnycdn, public-privacy media skip the gated /serve proxy and emit the CDN edge URL directly.
View Event Retention (days). Daily cron drops rows from mvs_media_views older than this window. Aggregates in mvs_media_stats unaffected. 0 = retain forever.
Compress uploaded JPEG/PNG/GIF via WP_Image_Editor. Temp-write + size-compare protects against re-encode inflation. Fires mvs_optimize_image filter so EWWW/Imagify/Smush/ShortPixel run alongside.
Emit WebP sibling for original + each thumbnail size. Stored as original_webp / thumb_*_webp meta. Only kept when strictly smaller than source. Uploaded to active cloud driver for cloud installs.

Emit AVIF sibling for original + each thumbnail size. AVIF is 30–50% smaller than WebP but encodes 3–10× slower. Requires AVIF-capable Imagick (libheif) or GD on PHP 8.1+ (libavif); silent no-op when unavailable. Default OFF (opt-in).
Anonymous opt-in local-only usage counters. Records event-name counters via TelemetryService (no user IDs, URLs, paths, or media content). Stays on-site; never transmitted. Disabled by default.

Stored filename strategy (hashed | original_sanitized). Existing media never renamed; only affects future uploads. Default 'original_sanitized' on upgrade; FilenameStrategy::DEFAULT_FRESH ('hashed') for fresh installs.

Global Allow Downloads toggle. Hides the lightbox Download button + gates the POST /mvs/v1/media/{id}/download REST endpoint (defense-in-depth: hiding the button alone wouldn't stop a determined caller). Per-media `allow_download` meta still applies on top of this.
Monthly $ cap. Conservative default of 10 USD so a fresh install never silently runs an unbounded OpenAI bill. Set to 0 in UI for unlimited spend.
Reports → auto-hide threshold. Set to 0 to disable.
Minimum account age (days). Accounts younger than this cannot send DMs. Set 0 to disable.
Where the floating slide-out chat icon appears for logged-in users. Consumed by Plugin::render_chat_panel() (wp_footer). Filterable per-page via mvs_should_render_chat_panel.
